review_notes: Independently reviewed the current 117-line proposal.json, complete 39-line functionality.md, complete 420-line fact ledger and complete 295-line link ledger. The proposal under review contains five fact writes, not the larger historical proposal embedded in context.

All five writes are supported: two correct the input predicate's canonical field and caller scope, one corrects the initializer's cleanup interpretation and XY scope, and two correct IASA's timer gating and success-versus-transition distinction. All writes target owned subjects; links, entities, merges and follow_ups are empty.

Read both complete owned files in canonical and rendered form and enumerated all 17 subjects, 44 facts and 14 links. Foreign canonical evidence independently verifies the Fall caller, active callback table, item-output contract, pickup-counter helper, stick-angle calculation, AirCatch restrictions, shared collision callback lifetime, alternate physics, FallSpecial branches and landing override.

The current artifacts explicitly defer unsupported numerical, gameplay and compiled-layout claims rather than retaining them as proved. Such deferral is acceptable for this pass; acceptance does not resolve those claims.
CheckInput and Enter remain descriptive naming hypotheses. Rendered helper aliases were not used as independent evidence. No gameplay interpretation was inferred from numeric throw-state identifiers.

The link ledger now uses only retain and unresolved and preserves the original baseline records. Retained relationships are supported independently of historical Discord provenance. Wording qualifications concerning synchronous callbacks and optional destinations are recorded below without proposing new links.

Boundary review confirms strict deadzones, XY-only replacement, nonzero rather than positive timer gating, early success bypassing decrement and AirCatch, and any nonzero command selecting shared physics. Actual tuning and target-specific exceptional arithmetic remain deferred.
